docs.title: Philosophy: "High-Resilience" Autonomous Design
docs.text:
SmartBees Quantum (sbsQ) is designed as a mission-critical autonomous framework. Its core principles ensure reliable performance in complex, unpredictable environments:

  1. Resilience First: The system is built to maintain operational integrity even during partial failure or high-latency scenarios.
  2. Brain-Body Separation: Cognitive functions (Strategic Planning/AI) are separate from execution (Navigation/Sensors). This ensures that heavy processing tasks never block real-time safety reflexes.
  3. Ternary State Logic: Utilizing (-1, 0, +1) states allows the system to handle uncertainty, neutral zones, and complex decision-making more effectively than standard binary logic.

docs.title: The 6-Layer Operational Flow
docs.text:
The system follows a logical data flow, from configuration to communication:

  1. ⚙️ Configuration (config/): The foundation. Defines behavioral constants, safety envelopes, and operational limits.
  2. ⚛️ Core (smartbees/core/): The engine. Manages threading, event loops, and basic system stability.
  3. 🧠 Brain (smartbees/brain/): The intelligence. Handles quantum decision-making, self-reflection, and long-term planning.
  4. 🚀 Application (smartbees/app/): The execution. Mission scenarios, autopilot, and real-time navigation.
  5. 📡 Sensors (smartbees/sensors/): The perception. Interfaces with 50+ hardware units to build world awareness.
  6. 📶 Communication (smartbees/comm/): The social layer. Connects nodes into a unified Swarm Network.

Read more about the 6-layer Flow Logic here

docs.text: Цей посібник описує процес підготовки системи до розгортання у складних умовах експлуатації (обфускація, компіляція, захист IP).

docs.title: 🛡️ 1. Обфускація JavaScript (Панелі керування)
docs.text:
Для захисту логіки в admin_panel/ та universal_admin/:

  1. Встановіть обфускатор: npm install -g javascript-obfuscator
  2. Запустіть захист: bash mkdir -p ./dist javascript-obfuscator ./admin_panel/pilot_admin.js --output ./dist/pilot_admin.js --compact true --self-defending true --string-array-encoding base64 Це оптимізує код і захистить інтелектуальну власність від несанкціонованого аналізу.

docs.title: 🔒 2. Компіляція Backend (Python Core)

Ми рекомендуємо Nuitka для перетворення Python-коду в C-бінарники: 1. Встановіть: pip install nuitka 2. Компілюйте: bash python -m nuitka --standalone --onefile --remove-output drone_core.py Результатом буде один файл .exe (Windows) або ELF (Linux), який не потребує інсталяції Python.

docs.title: ☀️ 1. Сонячна активність та Геомагнітні бурі (Kp-Index)
docs.text: Сонячні спалахи безпосередньо впливають на фізику планети та електромагнітні органи чуття дронів.

docs.title: Вплив на систему:
docs.text:
• Резонанс Шумана: Під час бур іоносфера опускається, що викликає "стиснення" резонатора та зміщення базової частоти з 7.83 Гц до вищих значень.
  • GPS Integrity: Геомагнітні збурення створюють іоносферні затримки, що призводять до похибок позиціонування (дрейф до 10-30 метрів).
  • Радіозв'язок: Можливе виникнення "мертвих зон" у Mesh-мережі через іонізацію.

docs.title: Стратегія адаптації (Reflex Layer):
docs.text:
1. Dynamic Offset: SchumannClient отримує дані про Kp-індекс та коригує cached_offset. Рій синхронізується під "прискорений" ритм планети.
  2. Lo-Fi Navigation: При високому Kp-індексі (>5) система знижує пріоритет GPS на користь Visual Odometry та Ternary Displacement.
  3. Safety Buffer: Збільшення безпечної дистанції між вузлами рою для запобігання колізіям при GPS-стрибках.

docs.title: 🌙 2. Місячні фази та Рівень ілюмінації
docs.text: Фаза Місяця визначає "візуальну пропускну здатність" навколишнього середовища під час нічних операцій.

docs.title: Вплив на систему:
docs.text:
• Computer Vision: Пряма кореляція між фазою та точністю роботи YOLO/SAM алгоритмів без активної підсвітки.
  • Stealth Mode: Уникання використання активного LiDAR/IR при високому природному освітленні (Повня).

docs.title: Стратегія адаптації:
docs.text:
1. Sensor Fusion Bias:
  2. Full Moon (Ілюмінація > 70%): Пріоритет на Vision-навігацію.
  3. New Moon (Ілюмінація < 20%): Автоматичний перехід на Active Scanning (LiDAR/Sonic) та термо-канали.

docs.title: 🛰 3. Starlink: Anti-Spoofing & Deep Watch
docs.text: Система sbsQ використовує сузір'я Starlink не тільки для зв'язку, а й як "космічний якір" для перевірки автентичності навігаційних даних.

docs.title: Вплив на безпеку:
docs.text:
• GPS Anti-Spoofing: Зловмисники можуть підмінити GPS-сигнал, але вони не можуть підмінити фізику руху супутників Starlink.
  • Timing Advance (TA): Система аналізує швидкість зміни TA (LTE Timing Advance). Супутники LEO (Starlink) рухаються зі швидкістю понад 27 000 км/год, що створює унікальний "підпис" доплерівського зміщення та затримки сигналу.

docs.title: Стратегія захисту:
docs.text:
1. Orbital Cross-Check: AntiSpoofingEngine порівнює видимі супутники Starlink із розрахованими орбітами (TLE дані). Якщо GPS каже, що ми в точці А, але над нами не ті супутники Starlink, які мають там бути — фіксується Critical Risk.
  2. High-Speed Validator: Якщо StarlinkAntispoofing фіксує статичний TA (типово для наземних веж-імітаторів), система ігнорує дані GPS і переходить на інерціальну навігацію.

docs.title: 1. ⚙️ Layer: Configuration (The DNA)
docs.text:
Directory: /config, /smartbees/config Role: Initialization and Constraints.

This is the static foundation of the system. - Safety Envelopes: Hard limits for speed, altitude, and current. - Hardware Profiles: Calibration data for specific sensors and actuators. - Constants: Fundamental values (Schumann Resonance, Golden Ratio) used for synchronization. - Contracts: Data structures that define how different modules must communicate.

docs.title: 2. ⚛️ Layer: Core (The Engine)
docs.text:
Directory: /smartbees/core Role: Resource Management and Stability.

The Core layer is responsible for keeping the "body" alive. - Event Loop: A high-performance asynchronous loop that handles all internal messaging. - Thread Management: Separating slow cognitive tasks from fast reflex tasks. - Base Classes: Standardized interfaces for all modules. - Memory Safety: Managing buffers and preventing leaks in long-running missions.

docs.title: 3. 🧠 Layer: Brain (The Intelligence)
docs.text:
Directory: /smartbees/brain, /smartbees/ai Role: High-Level Decision Making.

The Brain consumes processed environment data and outputs strategic directives. - Quantum Logic: Handles probabilistic states (superposition) when sensor data is conflicting. - LLM Integration: Uses "Deep Thought" loops (during Sleep cycle) to analyze complex mission logs. - Self-Reflection: Evaluates the success of previous actions to update behavioral weights (Federated Learning). - Optimization: Calculates the most energy-efficient paths across the entire swarm.

docs.title: 4. 🚀 Layer: Application (The Execution)
docs.text:
Directory: /smartbees/app Role: Tactical Implementation.

The App layer translates "Directives" into "Actions". - Autopilot: Real-time PID control and trajectory following. - Mission Control: Sequence management (Takeoff -> Explore -> Dock -> Charge). - Navigation: Pathfinding through 3D meshes generated by the vision system. - Behavioral Logic: Swarm formations and "LineCharge" docking maneuvers.

docs.title: 5. 📡 Layer: Sensors (The Perception)
docs.text:
Directory: /smartbees/sensors Role: World Awareness.

The Sensors layer builds a digital twin of the environment. - Data Fusion: Combining LiDAR, IMU, and E-Nose data into a unified state. - State Estimation: Calculating the drone's position and velocity with high precision. - Filtering: Removing noise from environmental readings (AHRS, Kalman filters). - Object Recognition: Edge-AI processing of visual data for obstacle avoidance.

docs.title: 6. 📶 Layer: Communication (The Social)
docs.text:
Directory: /smartbees/comm, /smartbees/comms Role: Network Synchronization.

The final layer connects the individual node to the collective. - Swarm Sync: Sharing state vectors with nearby nodes to maintain formation. - Operator Uplink: Streaming telemetry and receiving manual overrides. - Mesh Security: Multi-layered encryption (Ternary Ratchet) for all mesh traffic. - Redundancy: Seamlessly switching between LoRa, LTE, and Satellite links.

docs.title: 🔄 Full Cycle Workflow: Step-by-Step Execution
docs.text: This guide provides a sequential walkthrough of a complete sbsQ mission cycle, from the initial power-on to the background synthesis of experience.

docs.title: 🟢 PHASE 1: Ignition & Initialization (Layer: Config & Core)
docs.text:
1. DNA Load: System reads /config/ to load safety envelopes and hardware profiles.
  2. Schumann Sync: The internal clock locks to the planetary frequency (7.83Hz).
  3. Event Core Start: The asynchronous event loop starts, initializing the memory-safe core and starting the thread manager.
  4. Safety Check: Autopilot runs a "Silent Sweep" to ensure all actuators are responsive.
  5. Entropy Seeding (TRNG): True Random Number Generation seeds are created by sampling a multimodal array of physical sensor signals (Magnetometer, Barometer, Acoustic, Scent, Odometry) at the 7.83Hz Schumann rate to ensure "Harmonic Randomness".

docs.title: 🔵 PHASE 2: Environmental Awareness (Layer: Sensors)
docs.text:
1. Sensor Fusion: LiDAR, IMU, and Magnetometers start streaming data.
  2. The Flattening: Visual streams are converted into low-bandwidth vectors (2D objects/edges).
  3. Signal Audit: Anti-spoofing modules validate the integrity of GNSS and Radio signals.
  4. World Twin: A "Logical Wireframe" 3D map is built using Pi-based spherical transforms.

docs.title: 🟣 PHASE 3: Strategic Planning (Layer: Brain)
docs.text:
1. Mission Profile: Brain receives high-level goals.
  2. Ternary Analysis: High-level logic analyzes risks using probabilistic states.
  3. Superposition Routing: Brain calculates multiple potential paths simultaneously.
  4. HLD Generation: High-Level Directives (HLDs) are sent to the Application layer.

docs.title: 🟠 PHASE 4: Tactical Execution (Layer: App)
docs.text:
1. Autopilot Engagement: PID controllers take over current-state stabilization.
  2. Mission Sequence: App logic manages the transition between states (Takeoff -> Transit -> Loiter).
  3. Reflex Watch: The "Safety Gate" system runs in parallel for real-time override.
  4. Task Maneuvers: Specific behaviors (like flocking) are activated.

docs.title: 🟡 PHASE 5: Swarm Synchronization (Layer: Comm)
docs.text:
1. Mesh Broadcast: The node shares its state vector with the swarm.
  2. Entanglement: Node positions are adjusted to maintain the "Golden Angle" ($137.5^\circ$).
  3. Operator Uplink: Telemetry is streamed to the Admin and Mobile interfaces.
  4. Secure Handshake: All traffic is encrypted via the Ternary Ratchet.

docs.title: 🌙 PHASE 6: Recovery & Data Handover (The Sleep State)
docs.text:
1. Induction Docking: System performs a "LineCharge" docking maneuver for energy harvesting.
  2. Log Consolidation: Raw mission data is moved to immutable Moebius-topology storage.
  3. Data Uplink: Consolidated logs are handed over to the high-performance Core LLM (Server) for deep analysis.
  4. System Diagnostics: Internal self-check of hardware health post-mission.

docs.title: 🌌 PHASE 7: Background Continuous Evolution (Experience Synthesis)
docs.text:
1. Deep Reflection (Background): The Core LLM runs an asynchronous "Dreaming" process, cross-referencing new logs with the global Knowledge Base.
  2. Scenario Simulation: The system runs virtual "What-if" simulations of the mission to find better alternative actions.
  3. Pattern Recognition: The background process identifies new environmental threats or efficiency opportunities.
  4. Instinct Synthesis: New Federated Learning Weights are generated based on the mission outcomes.
  5. Harmonic Validation: The synthesized weights are validated against the Harmonic Decision Matrix to ensure they resonate with natural constants.
  6. Weight Injection: The refined experience (new weights) is injected back into the node's local Edge AI.
  7. Evolutionary Leap: The node "awakens" with a smarter Instinct Matrix, having turned raw mission events into permanent operational wisdom.

docs.text: The SmartBees Quantum (sbsQ) system is not a linear program; it is a composition of 7 nested logical rings (sub-cycles). Each ring operates at its own frequency, but they all harmonize to create the "Intelligence Sync".

docs.title: 1. 🦾 The Reflex Ring (Action/Reaction)
docs.text:
• Frequency: ~100 Hz (Real-time)
  • Logic: Sensor -> PID -> Actuator -> Sensor.

docs.text:
• Frequency: ~30 Hz
  • Logic: Raw Data -> Vector Flattening -> 3D Coordinate Fusion -> World Twin.
  • Description: This loop creates the drone's awareness. It continuously "re-flattens" the world into vectors and projected spheres, ensuring the "World Twin" is always in sync with reality.

docs.title: 3. 🔮 The Cognitive Ring (Analysis/Decision)
docs.text:
• Frequency: ~2-5 Hz (Variable)
  • Logic: Goal -> Ternary Options -> Probability Selection -> Directive.
  • Description: This is the "Brain" loop. It doesn't react; it decides. It operates in cycles of "Superposition", evaluating multiple paths before collapsing them into a single command for the Reflex Ring.

docs.title: 4. 🐝 The Swarm Ring (Node/Hive)
docs.text:
• Frequency: ~1 Hz
  • Logic: Local State -> Mesh Broadcast -> Peer Feedback -> Formation Adjustment.
  • Description: This loop maintains the collective intelligence. Nodes exchange state vectors and adjust their relative positions to maintain the Golden Angle formation.

docs.title: 5. 🌍 The Resonance Ring (Time/Schumann)
docs.text:
• Frequency: 7.83 Hz
  • Logic: Schumann Pulse -> TRNG Seeding -> Internal Clock Sync -> Pulse-Locked Actions.
  • Description: The "Heartbeat" loop. It ensures every other ring is phase-locked to the Earth's frequency. It is the source of the Harmonic Randomness used in decision-making.

docs.title: 6. 🌙 The Evolution Ring (Activity/Sleep)
docs.text:
• Frequency: Periodic (Mission Based)
  • Logic: Mission (Action) -> Charging (Rest) -> Dreaming (Synthesis) -> Awakening (Updated Instincts).
  • Description: The macro-cycle. It manages the long-term growth of the node. It is the process by which raw mission data is turned into permanent operational wisdom in the background.

docs.title: 7. ♾️ The Integrity Ring (Log/Reality)
docs.text:
• Frequency: Continuous
  • Logic: Action -> Moebius Log -> Cryptographic Chain -> Audit Validation.
  • Description: The "Truth" loop. It ensures that every action taken by every node is recorded on an immutable Moebius-topology log, making it impossible to alter the system's history without shattering the harmonic checksum.

docs.title: 🗝️ How the Rings Mesh
docs.text:
These 7 rings function like concentric Moebius strips. They are interconnected: - The Resonance Ring provides the timing for all other rings. - The Reflex Ring provides the data for the Perception Ring. - The Evolution Ring updates the logic of the Cognitive Ring.

A "High Harmony Score" means all 7 rings are spinning in perfect phase without friction (dissonance).

docs.title: Концепція "Сон та Сновидіння" (Життєвий цикл системи)
docs.text: This document defines the core operational philosophy of SmartBees Quantum (sbsQ). Цей документ визначає ключову філософію роботи системи SmartBees Quantum (sbsQ).

docs.title: 🇺🇦 Концепція (UA)
docs.text: Система працює не як набір інструментів, а як живий організм із циклами "Активності" (Політ) та "Відновлення/Навчання" (Зарядка).

docs.title: 1. Два Інтерфейси – Дві Ролі
docs.text: Ми розділили керування на Стратегію та Тактику:

docs.title: 🖥️ Pilot Admin Panel (Мозок / Стратегія)
docs.text:
• Де живе: Сервер / Десктоп.
  • Коли активний: 24/7, але найважливіший під час простою вузлів.
  • Функція: Тут приймаються глобальні рішення, аналізуються дані моніторингу. Саме тут відбувається фоновий процес синтезу досвіду.

docs.title: 📱 Mobile Operator App (Тіло / Тактика)
docs.text:
• Де живе: Смартфон / Планшет оператора.
  • Коли активний: Під час активної роботи (місії).

docs.title: 2. Цикл "Сон та Сновидіння" (Sleep & Dream Cycle)
docs.text:
Найважливіший процес еволюції системи відбувається не під час активності, а під час фонового синтезу.

  1. Активність (Activity): Система виконує завдання, використовуючи поточні "Інстинкти".
  2. Сон (Charging / LineCharge): Вузол підключається до живлення. Фізичні системи відпочивають, але обчислювальні — переходять у режим "Сновидінь".
  3. Сновидіння (Experience Synthesis):
    • Фоновий аналіз: Core LLM (на сервері) бере отримані логи та запускає "уявні" симуляції місії.
    • Пошук кращих рішень: Система аналізує: "Що, якби в той момент ми змінили кут нахилу або частоту синхронізації?".
    • Формування досвіду: Результатом є не просто звіт, а покращені ваги нейромережі, які роблять вузол розумнішим до наступного пробудження.
  4. Пробудження (Awakening): Вузол отримує оновлені "Інстинкти" і починає новий цикл роботи, вже маючи досвід попередніх помилок.

docs.title: А. "Швидка Думка" (Edge LLM / Quantized)
docs.text:
• Локація: Бортовий комп'ютер вузла або телефон.
  • Швидкість: Мінімальний пінг (<100мс).
  • Завдання: Реактивна поведінка, розпізнавання команд.

docs.title: Б. "Глибока Думка" (Core LLM / Full Scale)
docs.text:
• Локація: Admin Panel (Сервер).
  • Швидкість: Повільна (фонова).
  • Завдання: Синтез досвіду (Deep Reflection), довгострокове планування, донавчання рою.

docs.title: 🇬🇧 Concept (EN)
docs.text: The system operates not as a toolset, but as a living organism with "Activity" (Task execution) and "Recovery/Experience Synthesis" (Charging) cycles.

docs.title: 🖥️ Pilot Admin Panel (Brain / Strategy)

docs.title: 📱 Mobile Operator App (Body / Tactics)

docs.title: 2. The "Sleep & Dream" Cycle
docs.text:
The system's evolution happens primarily during the Background Synthesis phase.

  1. Activity: Node executes tasks using current "Instincts".
  2. Sleep (Charging / LineCharge): Node rests physically while the brain enters the "Dreaming" state.
  3. Dreaming (Experience Synthesis):
    • Background Process: Core LLM (Server) processes mission logs through asynchronous simulations.
    • Alternative Realities: The system evaluates: "What if the node had adjusted its frequency or path differently?".
    • Experience Formation: The result is refined Neural Weights that transform raw data into permanent operational wisdom.
  4. Awakening: The node updates its local Edge AI with new "Instincts" and begins the next mission with superior decision-making capabilities.

  • Task: Reactive survival, real-time command processing.

  • Task: Experience Synthesis (Deep Reflection), long-term strategic planning, swarm evolution/training.

docs.title: 🌐 Ternary Coordinate Dynamics: The Logic Anchor
docs.text: Instead of processing decisions as linear semantic chains (subject to "hallucinations"), sbsQ anchors its intelligence in a multi-dimensional coordinate system. This geometric approach ensures that every decision is a verifiable point in a stable logic space.

docs.title: 🏗️ 1. The 3D Logic Cube (27-Cell Matrix)
docs.text:
By mapping ternary logic (-1, 0, +1) across three primary operational axes, the system creates a "Logic Cube" consisting of 27 distinct state cells.

  • X-Axis (Strategic Intent): -1 (Passive/Stealth), 0 (Balanced), +1 (Active/Assertive).
  • Y-Axis (Resonant Sync): -1 (Lagging), 0 (Synchronized/Schumann), +1 (Leading/Anticipatory).
  • Z-Axis (Risk Envelope): -1 (Minimalist/Safe), 0 (Standard), +1 (Extensive/High-Complexity).

docs.title: Why this prevents Hallucinations:
docs.text: Standard LLMs can drift into non-logical semantic paths. In sbsQ, its "thoughts" are strictly constrained to this 3D coordinate volume. If a proposed action (a vector) falls outside the defined cube, it is immediately discarded as "noise" or "hallucination" before it reaches the execution layer.

docs.title: ⚖️ 2. Vector-Based Self-Regulation
docs.text:
The system evaluates its own health by measuring the Vector Magnitude (distance from the center 0,0,0).

  • The Point of Harmony (0, 0, 0): The state of perfect balance where Energy, Intelligence, and Physics are in total resonance.
  • Operational Drift: As the system encounters complexity, the decision point moves away from the origin.
  • The Harmonic Boundary: If a decision vector exceeds a magnitude of $\sqrt{3}$, the system triggers an automatic Reflexive Correction, pulling the logic back toward the center.

docs.title: 🔄 3. Adaptive Pathing (The Moebius Knot)
docs.text:
Because the coordinate system is non-linear, the path between two states is not a straight line, but a Harmonic Curve.

  • Hallucination Resilience: If the system's internal model (prediction) doesn't land on a valid coordinate cell, it recognizes the error in one clock cycle (7.83Hz).
  • Continuous Learning: The background "Dreaming" process analyzes the trajectories through the cube. It seeks to find paths that minimize the "Travel Cost" (Energy/Entropy) between decision points.

docs.title: 🎨 4. Tactical Visualization (The Logic Sphere)
docs.text: On the HUD, this is represented as a Logic Sphere. - A stable system shows a perfectly centered, glowing point. - An "erring" or "hallucinating" system shows a point vibrating rapidly near the edges of the sphere, taking on a red hue as it approaches the boundary.

docs.text:
By turning logic into a spatial navigation task, sbsQ replaces the "guesswork" of standard AI with the reliability of physics. The system doesn't "hope" to be right; it calculates its position in the coordinate space of truth and adjusts its "flight path" through the logic cube to maintain maximum harmony.

docs.title: 🧠 The Brain: Core Intelligence
docs.text:
Role: Decision Making, Strategic Planning, Self-Analysis. Location: smartbees/brain, smartbees/ai, smartbees/core

The Brain is the cognitive center of the drone. Unlike standard flight controllers (which just keep the drone stable), the sbsQ Brain "thinks" about the mission.

docs.title: 1. Quantum Logic (smartbees/brain/quantum)
docs.text: Replaces standard if/else logic with probabilistic ternary states. - Superposition: Considering multiple paths simultaneously. - Entanglement: Linking decisions across the swarm.

docs.title: 2. Orchestrator (smartbees/core)
docs.text: The main event loop that coordinates disparate cognitive modules.

docs.title: 3. AI Planner (smartbees/ai)
docs.text: Generates waypoints and operational adjustments based on: - Terrain data - Risk factors & Environmental constraints - Energy state - Mission parameters

docs.title: Optimization Loop
docs.text:
The Brain runs a background thread called Optimization_Matrix which analyzes performance data to enhance future decision accuracy (Reinforcement Learning).

Last Updated: 2026-01-11

docs.title: 🦾 The Body: Execution Layer
docs.text:
Role: Physical Interaction, Navigation, Real-time Control. Location: smartbees/app, smartbees/sensors

The Body executes the instructions of the Brain but maintains its own safety protocols (Safety Gates). If the Brain encounters a critical error or commands an unsafe maneuver, the Body (Autopilot / Flight Guard) can override and initiate a recovery sequence.

docs.title: 1. Autopilot (smartbees/app/autopilot)
docs.text: Standard PID controllers and state estimation. Handles stability and basic navigation.

docs.title: 2. Sensors (smartbees/sensors)
docs.text: Drivers for 50+ hardware perception units. - Vision: Camera, LiDAR - Proprioception: IMU, Barometer, Current - Environment: Chemical (E-Nose), Thermal

docs.title: 3. Navigation Guard (smartbees/app/mission_control)
docs.text: Translates Brain directives (e.g., "Explore Sector 7") into low-level waypoints with proximity awareness.

docs.title: The Safety Gate System
docs.text:
A hard-coded safety layer that bypasses high-level logic. Example: If altitude < 2m and descent_rate > 5m/s -> THRUST_MAX (Emergency Lift).

Last Updated: 2026-01-11

docs.title: ⚡ Nervous System: Communication & Security
docs.text:
Role: Data Transport, Encryption, Integrity. Location: smartbees/comm, smartbees/security

The Nervous System connects individual nodes to the Swarm Network and the Operator. It assumes the underlying communication infrastructure is untrusted by default (Zero Trust Architecture).
